author: MZaplotnik
attribution: Photo: MZaplotnik, CC BY-SA 3.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Slovenian_Sign_18.JPG. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Wooden hiking fingerposts in Triglav National Park. Clear: red-brown 'USKOVNICA' arrow and dark 'PL.ŠEH' arrow on the right post, 'Konjska dolina' on the left board followed by a hand-painted distance (about '4.8 km', decimal mark unclear, not transcribed). The weathered lower-right board ('Uskovnica Triglav 6h / 0.7 km', faded) is not part of the target lines.
source_categories: Hiking and footpath signs in Slovenia

author: Doremo

author: Doremo
attribution: Photo: Doremo, CC BY 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:%C4%8Cir%C4%8Di%C4%8De_Slovenia_-_sign_2.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/. Unmodified original.
